summary_en: 2,329,100 shares (1.6% of shares outstanding), ¥12.09 billion upper limit, open-market acquisition on Tokyo Stock Exchange, 9 Jul 2026–31 Mar 2027. Authorization follows strategic partnership with Japan Activation Capital and third-party share allotment; buyback intended to offset dilution from treasury-share disposal.
